content.query:
AppTraces
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h) and AppRoleName == "tv3-export-worker"
| where Message startswith "export_processing_result "
| extend Outcome = extract(@"outcome=([A-Z_]+)", 1, Message)
| summarize Deliveries=sum(ItemCount) by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Outcome
content.title: Export delivery outcomes

content.query:
AppTraces
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h) and AppRoleName == "tv3-export-worker"
| where Message startswith "export_processing_result outcome=DURABLY_COMPLETED"
| extend DurationMs = tolong(extract(@"durationMs=([0-9]+)", 1, Message))
| summarize P95Ms=percentile(DurationMs, 95) by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
content.title: Export processing p95 (ms)

content.query:
AppTraces
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h) and AppRoleName == "tv3-export-worker"
| where Message == "export_tenant_mismatch"
| summarize Rejections=sum(ItemCount) by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
content.title: Forged tenant rejections

content.query:
AppTraces
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h) and AppRoleName == "tv3-export-worker"
| where Message startswith "event=worker_poll_failed "
| summarize Failures=sum(ItemCount) by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
content.title: Queue polling failures
